roleContext.roleTitle: Supply Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Collaboration
roleContext.jobDescription: The supply chain collaboration service runs shared planning between a manufacturer and its tier-one suppliers. The Supply Planning Analyst owns the weekly supply plan for an assigned product family, has authority to release purchase schedules to suppliers, leads the weekly supplier planning call, and is accountable for schedule adherence in that family.

requirements.text: Owns the weekly supply plan for an assigned product family and releases purchase schedules to suppliers under own authority.
Maintains the planning parameters (lead times, safety stock, lot sizes) in the planning system.
Leads the weekly supplier planning call and records decisions and actions.
Coordinates plan changes with production and logistics and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions at the end of each planning week.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Supply Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Collaboration

## Experience

- Maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family in the planning system, updating lead times and safety stock after each supplier review and logging every change with its reason.
- Prepared the draft weekly supply plan and the exception list for the family; the senior planner reviewed the draft and released the purchase schedules to suppliers under her authority.
- Took the minutes of the weekly supplier planning call chaired by the senior planner, tracked the actions in the shared log and chased suppliers for confirmations between calls.
- Passed plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging the ones that needed the senior planner's decision and recording who decided in the change log.
- Responsibilities included parameter maintenance, draft-plan preparation, call minutes and change logging for the small-appliance family over about two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one week's draft supply plan with the exception list and the change log for that week, with the planning system's plan identifiers as a verification trail.
